title: Near the Cross
studyTransform: Upper MIDI track; highest note at simultaneous onsets; first 32 bars; durations quantized to sixteenth notes. Accompaniment and performance markings omitted.
sourceLabel: Mutopia Project · edition and public-domain declaration
rights: The composition and this Mutopia edition are supplied as Public Domain. Edition source: CyberHymnal. The included PDF and original MIDI are unchanged. The editable notation is a 16-bar upper-part study (maximum 32 bars) derived from the MIDI, not the complete score.
description: Hymn music for Voice and Piano. Complete source PDF plus an editable upper-part practice study.
attribution: W. H. Doane (1832–1915); Jefferson dos Santos Felix
compositionStatus: Public-domain composition and edition as declared by source
